nodes.name: POST sungrow-refresh-tokens Edge Function
nodes.notes:
TODO(phase-9): implement supabase/functions/sungrow-refresh-tokens/index.ts
Logic:
  - SELECT all rows from inverter_monitoring_credentials WHERE brand='sungrow' AND config->>'oauth_status'='authorized'
  - For each row: if access_token_expires_at - now < 5 days, call iSolarCloud token refresh endpoint
  - Update config->>'access_token' and config->>'access_token_expires_at'
  - If refresh fails, set config->>'oauth_status' = 'refresh_failed'
Sungrow refresh endpoint: POST {api_base}/openapi/refreshAccessToken
  Headers: x-access-key: {SUNGROW_APPKEY}
  Body: { refresh_token: config->>'refresh_token' }
